description: This file defines a custom exception class `ReviewServiceException` within the `OrangeHRM\tPerformance\Exception` namespace, used for handling specific errors related to review services in the OrangeHRM performance module. The class includes static methods that generate exceptions with specific error messages.

classes.name: ReviewServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods to create exceptions with standardized error messages related to performance review services.

methods.name: activateWithoutJobTitle
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that review activation cannot proceed for employees without a Job Title with KPI.

methods.name: activateWithoutKPI
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that review activation cannot proceed without KPIs.

methods.name: pastEmployeeForReviewer
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a past employee cannot be assigned as a reviewer.

methods.name: invalidSupervisor
methods.description: Creates an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that the selected supervisor for reviewer is invalid.
